name: lambda: a call by name
source: const dbl = x => x * 2; dbl(4)

name: lambda: a call in an argument of another call
source: const add = (a, b) => a + b; add(1, add(2, 3))

name: lambda: a lambda with no parameters
source: const seven = () => 7; seven() + 1

name: lambda: _ as the one parameter, called by name
lambda: _ => e passed to map
source: xs.map(_ => 0)

name: lambda: (_, i) => i takes the index
source: xs.map((_, i) => i)

name: lambda: a lambda with fewer parameters than the library gives
lambda: an omitted argument takes the default
source: const f = (x, n = 2) => x * n; f(3)

name: lambda: a null argument takes the default
source: const f = (x, n = 2) => x * n; f(3, null)

name: lambda: a given argument replaces the default
source: const f = (x, n = 2) => x * n; f(3, 4)

name: lambda: a zero argument does not take the default
source: const f = (x, n = 2) => x * n; f(3, 0)

name: lambda: a default sees the parameters to its left
source: const f = (a, b = a * 2) => a + b; f(5)

name: lambda: a default is not evaluated when the argument is given
source: const f = (a, b = 1 / z) => a + b; f(1, 2)

name: lambda: a default is evaluated when the argument is omitted, and can fail
source: const f = (a, b = 1 / z) => a + b; f(1)

name: lambda: a default is evaluated for a null argument, and can fail
source: const f = (a, b = 1 / z) => a + b; f(1, null)

name: lambda: a default is charged when it is evaluated
source: const f = (x, n = 2 * 3) => x + n; f(1)

name: lambda: a default is not charged when it is not evaluated
lambda: arguments are evaluated left to right before the call
source: const f = (a, b) => a + b; f(xs[5], 1 / d)

name: lambda: a failing argument means the call is not charged
source: const f = x => x; f(1 / d)

name: lambda: a failure in the body has the span in the body
source: const f = x => 10 / x; f(0)

name: lambda: a body reads a const above it
source: const k = 3; const f = x => x * k; f(2)

name: lambda: a body reads a variable of the environment
source: const f = x => x + base; f(1)

name: lambda: a body reads the name in scope where the lambda is written, not a later line
source: const f = x => x + k; const k = 100; f(1)

name: lambda: a lambda in a block reads the block's line
source: { const k = 2; const f = x => x * k; f(5) }

name: lambda: a parameter hides an outer const
source: const x = 100; const f = x => x + 1; f(1)

name: lambda: a parameter hides a variable of the environment
source: const f = n => n * 2; f(5)

name: lambda: a body that is a map literal
source: const mk = x => {id: x}; mk(3)

name: lambda: a body that is a block
source: const f = x => { const y = x + 1; y * y }; f(2)

name: lambda: one const-bound lambda calls another
source: const inc = x => x + 1; const twice = x => inc(inc(x)); twice(1)

name: lambda: an inner lambda of the same name calls the outer one
source: const f = x => x + 1; { const f = x => f(x) * 2; f(3) }

name: lambda: no recursion, the name is not in scope in its own body
lambda: a call by name with too few arguments is arity
source: const add = (a, b) => a + b; add(1)

name: lambda: a call by name with too many arguments is arity
source: const add = (a, b) => a + b; add(1, 2, 3)

name: lambda: a parameter with a default may be left out of a call by name
source: const f = (a, b = 1, c = 2) => a + b + c; f(10)

name: lambda: passed by name to map
source: const dbl = x => x * 2; xs.map(dbl)

name: lambda: passed by name to filter
source: const big = x => x > 1; xs.filter(big)

name: lambda: passed by name to reduce
source: const plus = (a, b) => a + b; xs.reduce(plus, 0)

name: lambda: one lambda called by name and passed by name
source: const dbl = x => x * 2; [dbl(1), ...xs.map(dbl)]

name: lambda: a lambda written in place charges its step each time it is evaluated
source: xs.map(x => ys.map(y => x * y))

name: lambda: a lambda passed to map reads an outer const
source: const k = 10; xs.map(x => x + k)

name: lambda: a parameter in map hides an outer const
source: const x = 100; xs.map(x => x * 2)

name: lambda: a failing body stops the library call
source: xs.map(x => 10 / x)

name: lambda: a lambda passed in place calls a const-bound lambda
source: const pos = x => x > 0; xs.filter(x => pos(x))

name: lambda: map with no elements calls no lambda
source: xs.map(x => 1 / x)

name: lambda: a const-bound lambda that is never called is never run
source: const boom = x => fail("never"); 1

name: lambda: a body with an if reads its parameter
source: const sign = n => if (n > 0) { "+" } else if (n < 0) { "-" } else { "0" }; [sign(3), sign(-2), sign(0)]

name: lambda: a body with a match
source: const name = c => match c { 1 => "one", 2 => "two", _ => "many" }; name(2)

name: lambda: a lambda with a list body called twice
source: const pair = (a, b) => [a, b]; [pair(1, 2), pair(3, 4)]
